brands.name: Rolex
brands.story: Rolex needs little introduction — its name is synonymous with timeless design and peerless recognition. Our catalogue features a select number of Rolex references, subject to availability.

brands.name: OMEGA
brands.story: From the Moonwatch to the depths of the ocean, OMEGA has defined Swiss precision for over a century. A cornerstone of our luxury selection.

panel.title: Precision Meets Heritage
panel.copy: Swiss watchmaking with a legacy written in space, sea and sport.

brands.name: Tissot
brands.story: Tissot brings Swiss craftsmanship to everyday wear — from the cult-favourite PRX to timeless dress pieces.

brands.name: Seiko
brands.story: From the beloved Presage to the legendary Prospex, Seiko delivers heritage, innovation and remarkable value.

panel.title: Japanese Watchmaking Excellence
panel.copy: Heritage, innovation and value from Japan's most storied manufacture.

brands.name: G-SHOCK
brands.story: Engineered for absolute toughness, G-SHOCK has been the definitive adventure watch since 1983.

panel.title: Built for the Bold
panel.copy: Shock-resistant engineering with unmistakable street presence.

brands.name: Casio
brands.story: From the retro charm of the Vintage series to the refined Edifice line, Casio is everyday dependability.

brands.name: Citizen
brands.story: Citizen pioneered light-powered precision. Eco-Drive and the Promaster series remain favourites worldwide.

brands.name: Orient
brands.story: Orient crafts in-house automatic movements at remarkable prices — the Bambino is a modern classic.

brands.name: Fossil
brands.story: Fossil blends American design with accessible prices — from minimal dials to chronograph classics.

brands.name: Tudor
brands.story: Tudor pairs tool-watch heritage with modern Swiss engineering. The Black Bay is a contemporary icon.

brands.name: TAG Heuer
brands.story: TAG Heuer's racing DNA runs through the Carrera and Aquaracer — bold, precise and unmistakable.

brands.name: Longines
brands.story: Longines has stood for refined Swiss elegance since 1832 — the Master Collection is its signature.

brands.name: Cartier
brands.story: Cartier's Tank and Santos defined the wristwatch as an object of design. A select few references pass through our collection.

brands.name: Breitling
brands.story: Breitling builds instruments for the skies and seas — the Navitimer and Superocean remain benchmarks.

brands.name: Grand Seiko
brands.story: Grand Seiko's Zaratsu-polished cases and hand-finished dials represent the pinnacle of Japanese watchmaking.

brands.name: Hamilton
brands.story: From the silver screen to the battlefield, Hamilton's Khaki and Jazzmaster lines are legends of utility and style.

brands.name: Rado
brands.story: Rado's pioneering use of high-tech ceramics makes its Captain Cook and True lines instantly recognisable.

brands.name: Michael Kors
brands.story: Michael Kors timepieces bring runway glamour to everyday wrists — gold tones, bold dials, unmistakable presence.

brands.name: Emporio Armani
brands.story: Emporio Armani translates Italian tailoring into timepieces of understated confidence.
